parameters.content:
## Lead auto-reply
Replies to every website inquiry within a minute, logs it to a Leads sheet, and pings you with the details.

**Setup (15 min)**
1. Fill in **Config** (business facts matter: Claude only uses what you write there).
2. Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and Anthropic credentials.
3. Point your website form's webhook at this workflow's **Production URL** (open "Lead form webhook").
4. Send a test inquiry with **test_mode = true**.
5. Set **test_mode = false** and activate.

**No AI?** Deactivate "Draft reply with Claude" (select it, press D). The template replies take over.

### Claude drafts, rules decide
Claude writes a reply from your business facts only. If the API fails, declines, or returns something odd, the template from Config is sent instead, so a lead never goes unanswered.

assignments.name: business_facts
assignments.value:
Licensed and insured residential plumber serving Springfield and nearby towns since 2009.
Services: leak and burst-pipe repair, water heaters (repair and install), drain cleaning, bathroom and kitchen plumbing.
Emergency call-outs available 24/7 for active leaks.
Free written estimates for jobs over $500. We do not quote prices by email; a plumber confirms the price on site before starting.

assignments.name: reply_tone
assignments.value: warm, plain-spoken and professional; no hype, no exclamation marks

assignments.name: reply_in_hours
assignments.value:
Hi {first_name},

Thanks for getting in touch about {service}. We have your message and someone from our team will contact you {response_time}.

If it is urgent, call us on {business_phone}.

{sender_name}

assignments.name: reply_after_hours
assignments.value:
Hi {first_name},

Thanks for getting in touch about {service}. Our office is closed right now, and we will contact you {response_time}.

If it is an emergency, call us on {business_phone}.

{sender_name}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.valid, message: $json.valid ? 'Thanks, we received your message.' : 'Please enter a valid email address.' }) }}

meta.description: Answers website inquiries in under a minute with a Claude-drafted (or template) reply, logs the lead and alerts the owner.
